title: Clear packages for websites, web apps, and SaaS builds
description: Choose a starting point based on scope. Every package includes discovery, responsive UI, and a production-ready handoff.

plans.name: Starter
plans.description: For businesses that need a polished marketing site with contact flows and SEO basics.

plans.name: Business App
plans.description: For teams launching a custom web application with dashboards, auth, and Laravel API integration.

plans.name: SaaS Platform
plans.description: For products that need subscriptions, role-based access, billing UI, and long-term scalability.

note: Final pricing depends on features, integrations, timeline, and content readiness. We share a detailed estimate after discovery.

faqs.question: Are these fixed prices?
faqs.answer: They are starting points. After discovery, we confirm scope, timeline, and a detailed quote before work begins.

faqs.question: Do you only build the frontend?
faqs.answer: Our core delivery is Next.js frontend work. We integrate with Laravel APIs and can collaborate with your backend team or recommend implementation partners.

faqs.question: Can I start small and expand later?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many clients begin with a marketing site or MVP and grow into dashboards, billing, and additional modules over time.

faqs.question: What is included after launch?
faqs.answer: Each package includes launch support. Ongoing maintenance, new features, and retainers can be arranged separately.

ctaDescription: Tell us what you are building and we will recommend the right scope, timeline, and budget range.
